text: Walking tree root, taking true child whenever flower’s measurement node’s threshold, gives Core ML’s answer. tree gets 146 150 flowers right. predictions match Core ML returns model, checked Mac MLModel.predict() coremltools.
code: predict_tree <- function(x) {   node <- tree[tree$id == 0, ]   while (node$behavior != "LeafNode") {     go_true <- x[[node$feature]] <= node$threshold     node <- tree[tree$id == if (go_true) node$if_true else node$if_false, ]   }   classes[which.max(leaf_probs[as.character(node$id), ])] }  predicted <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(iris)), \(i) predict_tree(iris[i, ]), "") table(predicted = predicted, actual = iris$Species) #>             actual #> predicted    setosa versicolor virginica #>   setosa         50          0         0 #>   versicolor      0         47         1 #>   virginica       0          3        49

Uses bundled copy 'upb' runtime (https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf), system 'protobuf' library required. Schemas compiled descriptor sets beforehand, 'protoc' 'buf'.
